findings.title: MFA registration coverage
findings.insurer_question_text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all users, including email, remote access and admin accounts?
findings.summary: 5 of 58 enabled users (8.6%) have no second sign-in factor registered.
findings.remediation: Require MFA for all users through Conditional Access or Security Defaults; chase the unregistered users.

findings.title: Conditional Access policies enforce MFA
findings.insurer_question_text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all users, including email, remote access and admin accounts?
findings.summary: Conditional Access requires MFA for all users and all apps (Require MFA for all users).
findings.remediation: Create a Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all users and all cloud apps, with a break-glass exclusion.

findings.title: Legacy authentication blocked
findings.insurer_question_text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all users, including email, remote access and admin accounts?
findings.summary: Legacy authentication is blocked by Block legacy authentication and no legacy sign-ins succeeded in the last 30 days.
findings.remediation: Block legacy authentication with Conditional Access and disable SMTP AUTH per mailbox.

findings.title: Security Defaults or equivalent policy
findings.insurer_question_text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all users, including email, remote access and admin accounts?
findings.summary: Security Defaults is off, but Conditional Access requires MFA for everyone and blocks legacy authentication.
findings.remediation: Enable Security Defaults if Conditional Access is not licensed or configured.

findings.title: Number of Global Administrators
findings.insurer_question_text: Are privileged accounts limited, separate from daily-use accounts, and reviewed?
findings.summary: 3 Global Administrators, all on dedicated accounts without a mailbox.
findings.remediation: Keep 2 to 4 Global Admins, use least-privilege roles for everyone else, and separate admin accounts from daily mail accounts.

findings.title: All admins protected by MFA
findings.insurer_question_text: Are privileged accounts limited, separate from daily-use accounts, and reviewed?
findings.summary: All 3 privileged accounts are registered for MFA.
findings.remediation: Require MFA, preferably phishing-resistant, for every privileged role.

findings.title: External mail forwarding and inbox rules
findings.insurer_question_text: Are SPF, DKIM and DMARC in place, and is external auto-forwarding blocked?
findings.summary: 1 inbox rule(s) forward or redirect mail to addresses outside the company.
findings.remediation: Block automatic external forwarding in the outbound spam policy and review existing rules.

findings.title: SPF, DKIM and DMARC configured
findings.insurer_question_text: Are SPF, DKIM and DMARC in place, and is external auto-forwarding blocked?
findings.summary: SPF, DKIM and an enforcing DMARC policy are in place on all 2 sending domains.
findings.remediation: Publish SPF, enable DKIM signing for each domain, and move DMARC to p=quarantine then p=reject.

findings.title: Anonymous sharing links
findings.insurer_question_text: Is external and anonymous file sharing controlled?
findings.summary: Anyone-with-the-link sharing is on for SharePoint and OneDrive and link expiry could not be confirmed (that setting is only visible in SharePoint PowerShell).
findings.remediation: Set SharePoint and OneDrive sharing to "new and existing guests" or stricter, and expire links.

findings.title: Guest users reviewed
findings.insurer_question_text: Is external and anonymous file sharing controlled?
findings.summary: All 2 guest accounts were active in the last 90 days.
findings.remediation: Review guests quarterly and remove inactive ones.

findings.title: Unified audit log enabled
findings.insurer_question_text: Are audit logs enabled and retained for at least 90 days?
findings.summary: The unified audit log is on with 180 days of retention.
findings.remediation: Enable the unified audit log and confirm retention meets 90 days or more.

findings.title: Microsoft Secure Score
findings.insurer_question_text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all users, including email, remote access and admin accounts?
findings.remediation: Work through the top improvement actions, prioritising identity.

findings.title: EDR on 95% or more of endpoints
findings.insurer_question_text: Is endpoint detection and response deployed on at least 95% of endpoints?
findings.summary: This cannot be read from the tenant. The client confirms it and supplies the evidence.
findings.remediation: Deploy an EDR such as Defender for Business or a managed EDR; export the device coverage report as evidence.
findings.evidence_requested: Device coverage export from the EDR console

findings.title: Backups immutable and restore-tested quarterly
findings.insurer_question_text: Are backups immutable or offline, and restore-tested at least quarterly?
findings.summary: This cannot be read from the tenant. The client confirms it and supplies the evidence.
findings.remediation: Back up Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace with a third-party tool, keep an immutable copy, and record quarterly restore tests.
findings.evidence_requested: Backup job report and dated restore test record

findings.title: Incident response plan tested in the last 12 months
findings.insurer_question_text: Is there a written incident response plan, tested in the last 12 months?
findings.summary: This cannot be read from the tenant. The client confirms it and supplies the evidence.
findings.remediation: Adopt the Alimi incident response plan template and run a one-hour tabletop; keep the after-action notes.
findings.evidence_requested: Plan document and dated tabletop notes

insurer_answers.question_text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all users, including email, remote access and admin accounts?
Are privileged accounts limited, separate from daily-use accounts, and reviewed?
Are SPF, DKIM and DMARC in place, and is external auto-forwarding blocked?
Is external and anonymous file sharing controlled?
Are audit logs enabled and retained for at least 90 days?
Is endpoint detection and response deployed on at least 95% of endpoints?
Are backups immutable or offline, and restore-tested at least quarterly?
Is there a written incident response plan, tested in the last 12 months?

notes: Sample tenant for the Alimi demo. Fictional company; nothing here was read from a real tenant.
